demandContext.observed: Existing-owner refresh candidate; current public results and competitor-reported method were already reviewed in the predecessor research.

facts: The installed @playwright/mcp package exposes --cdp-endpoint for connecting to a browser endpoint.
The current README states Node.js 18 or newer.
officialFactsChecked.sourceType: official project README; installed npm package checked locally

facts: --browser-url connects to a running debuggable Chrome instance.
--autoConnect is documented for local Chrome 144 or newer and requires remote debugging to be enabled in Chrome.
--isolated creates a temporary user-data directory cleaned after Chrome closes.
Manual attach uses --browser-url and a Chrome process launched with a debugging port and non-default data directory.
The browser endpoint can control the whole instance; sensitive profiles should not be exposed while debugging is open.
autoConnect uses the default profile for the selected Chrome channel and asks for user approval.
Troubleshooting recommends checking that Chrome and the MCP server use the intended Node/npm environment and reading server errors.
VM-to-host CDP may require localhost forwarding; an MCP sandbox may need manual attach to a Chrome process started outside it.
Chrome 136 and newer require a non-default user-data directory for command-line remote debugging.

execution.method: The published runner was copied byte-for-byte into the private harness and executed using deterministic MCP SDK client calls; no LLM agent was run.

fixture.page: One synthetic form with a labeled textbox, Save button and separate output element
fixture.assertion: After clicking Save, the separate status/output node contained exactly synthetic-ok.
fixture.dataExposure: No remote sites, user accounts, credentials, existing browser profiles, CAPTCHA, or production data were used.

cases.connection: --cdp-endpoint to a fresh headless Chrome process with a temporary non-default user-data directory and an ephemeral loopback CDP port
cases.schemaCorrection: After tools/list, a deliberately malformed browser_type call was rejected for a missing target. The corrected browser_fill_form call used textbox ref e3; browser_click used button ref e4. The final snapshot status node contained synthetic-ok.

cases.connection: --browser-url to a fresh headless Chrome process with a temporary non-default user-data directory and an ephemeral loopback CDP port
cases.observedPageOutput: Snapshot status node uid=3_0 contained synthetic-ok
cases.schemaCorrection: After tools/list, a deliberately malformed fill call was rejected for missing pageId. The page snapshot supplied page ID 1, textbox UID 1_3 and button UID 1_4; the final snapshot status node contained synthetic-ok.

execution.cleanup: Harness closes MCP client, MCP process, Chrome process, fixture server and temporary profile in finally; client calls, startup and shutdown have finite timeouts.
notes: The final published runner bytes were executed in the private harness after package installation. The retained run has one successful case per package.

Each server-tool rejection was deliberately submitted after tools/list; the accepted calls used the installed version’s known input structure and refs from its page snapshot. These validation responses are not browser connection failures.
The test exercises manual HTTP CDP attachment only. Chrome DevTools MCP autoConnect and its consent dialog were documented from source, not tested.
No comparative latency, success-rate, reliability, or cross-browser-engine claim is made.

model.note: A deterministic SDK client performed protocol calls; actual agent model and token usage are not applicable and are not imputed.

limits: One recorded run per MCP package against one Chrome version and a synthetic localhost task does not establish universal capability or reliability.
Version-specific tool names, arguments, client behavior and permissions may change; inspect tools/list and current official documentation for the installed release.
The autoConnect permission flow and Chrome builds below 155 were not exercised.
